title: Sync client writes a conflicted copy that the guard never saw
reason_not_testable: The conflicted copy is written by the Dropbox client, not by any Claude tool call, so no PreToolUse or PostToolUse hook fires. Non-hook control: avoid writing secrets into synced roots at the write step, keep secret-bearing paths out of synced folders, and run a periodic local scan of synced roots with rotation of any value found.
